content: Scholars who do not satisfy the scholarship retention requirements may submit an appeal through the Iskolaris portal by uploading an appeal letter and the necessary supporting documents. All appeals are reviewed, and applicants are notified of the final decision through the system.

DOST-SEI Scholarship - The scholar must upload their Enrollment Assessment Form (EAF) and previous term's grades. If the retention requirements are met, the scholarship will be automatically renewed. Animo Grants Scholarship Program - The scholar must upload their Enrollment Assessment Form (EAF) and previous term's grades. If the retention requirements are met, the scholarship will be automatically renewed. Archer Achiever Scholarship - The scholar must upload their Enrollment Assessment Form (EAF) and previous term's grades. If the retention requirements are met, the scholarship will be automatically renewed. Star Scholars Program - The scholar must upload their Enrollment Assessment Form (EAF) and previous term's grades. If the retention requirements are met, the scholarship will be automatically renewed. St. La Salle Financial Assistance Grant - The scholar must upload their Enrollment Assessment Form (EAF) and previous term's grades. If the retention requirements are met, the scholarship will be automatically renewed.

DOST-SEI Scholarship - The DOST-SEI Scholarship requires scholars to maintain a TGPA of at least 2.5 with no failing grades. Animo Grants Scholarship Program - The Animo Grants Scholarship Program requires scholars to maintain a TGPA of at least 2.5 with no failing grades. Archer Achiever Scholarship - The Archer Achiever Scholarship requires scholars to maintain a TGPA of at least 2.5 with no failing grades. Star Scholars Program - The Star Scholars Program requires scholars to maintain a TGPA of at least 2.5 with no failing grades. St. La Salle Financial Assistance Grant - The St. La Salle Financial Assistance Grant requires scholars to maintain a TGPA of at least 2.0 with no failing grades.

DOST-SEI Scholarship - The scholar will receive Php 8,000 per month. Animo Grants Scholarship Program - The scholar will receive Php 40,000.00 per term. Archer Achiever Scholarship - The scholar will receive a 100% tuition fee discount. Star Scholars Program - The scholar will receive Php 18,000 per month. St. La Salle Financial Assistance Grant - The scholar will receive a tuition fee discount of 100%, 75%, 50%, or 25%, depending on the awarded tuition fee discount.
